# WO-005: Make exposure-card results and limits clear
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: app-ui
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)
Drafted by: Elena Vasquez (Codex lead); approved by Morgan Reyes 2026-11-07

## Goal
Felix Grant: improve the existing exposure card's presentation without
changing discovery, matching, scoring, or workflow behavior.
One or two sessions.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Preserve exposure_card's interface and existing engine integration.
- Clearly distinguish a missing engine, no saved result, an unavailable
  result, and a completed result containing zero found listings.
- Zero found listings must not imply that the person is absent from
  every website. Explain that results cover the sites checked.
- Preserve the numeric score and explanation data. Explain that the
  score describes this check, not a person's overall safety.
- Correct singular/plural wording for found and manual-check counts.
  Keep the checked date visible.
- Escape all rendered explanation text; raw exception text never
  reaches the page.
- Add fake-result tests for each state, zero/one/multiple counts,
  hostile explanation text, and engine failure.
- Card remains readable at 1024x768 with 150% scaling, at 200% zoom,
  and in light/dark modes. No new interactive controls or JavaScript.
- Targeted tests and existing wizard v0.3 tests pass; changed Python
  files are typed and ruff-clean.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- src/freemyid/wizard/views.py
  (exposure_card and exposure-card-only helpers only)
- tests/test_wizard_exposure_card.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Other views.py functions, engine/exposure.py, exposure models, scoring,
storage, server.py, consent/practice behavior, network, sending,
CSS/tokens, CI/release, and every WO-002 path.

## Check-in plan
After session one: show rendered examples for all four result states
and report any uncertainty in the engine contract.
At completion: provide regression and layout results.
